metadata.question: Was there more green vegetation visible around Onemen Bay near Anadyr on August 9, 2025, than on September 11, 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Onemen Bay near Anadyr, Russia (approximately 64.7°N, 177.5°E) - Dates: August 9, 2025 and September 11, 2025 - Collection: Sentinel-2 L2A (harmonized) for vegetation analysis via NDVI - Fallback: Landsat 8/9 if Sentinel-2 unavailable 2. Masking strategy: - Yes, mask clouds using SCL band for Sentinel-2 or QA_PIXEL for Landsat - Question is about vegetation visibility, so cloud masking is essential 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: NDVI can legitimately be near 0 (water, bare soil) or low in September (vegetation senescence in Arctic) - C1: If no images found for either date - C2: If images exist but all pixels masked out - C3: If NDVI calculation returns None/NaN or is outside [-1, 1] range - A/B: Compare mean NDVI values; higher NDVI in August = more green vegetation = Answer A ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([177.5, 64.7]); const region = point.buffer(5000); // 5km radius around Onemen Bay const date1Start = '2025-08-07'; const date1End = '2025-08-11'; const date2Start = '2025-09-09'; const date2End = '2025-09-13'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const scl = image.select('SCL'); const mask = scl.neq(3).and(scl.neq(8)).and(scl.neq(9)).and(scl.neq(10)); return image.updateMask(mask); } let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(date1Start, date1End) .map(maskS2clouds); let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(date2Start, date2End) .map(maskS2clouds); const size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Aug 2025 Images: ${size1}`); console.log(`Sep 2025 Images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log('Trying Landsat 8/9 fallback...'); function maskL8clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } col1 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .merge(ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2')) .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(date1Start, date1End) .map(maskL8clouds); col2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .merge(ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2')) .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(date2Start, date2End) .map(maskL8clouds); const size1L = await col1.size().getInfo(); const size2L = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat Aug: ${size1L}, Sep: ${size2L}`); if (size1L === 0 || size2L === 0) { console.log('No data available for one or both dates.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Calculate NDVI function addNDVI(image) { const nir = image.select('B8'); const red = image.select('B4'); const ndvi = nir.subtract(red).divide(nir.add(red)).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); } const img1 = col1.map(addNDVI).select('NDVI').median(); const img2 = col2.map(addNDVI).select('NDVI').median(); // 4. Check pixel counts const count1 = await img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const count2 = await img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Aug pixels: ${count1}, Sep pixels: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 5. Calculate mean NDVI const ndvi1 = await img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const ndvi2 = await img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Aug NDVI: ${ndvi1}`); console.log(`Sep NDVI: ${ndvi2}`); // 6. Validation & Answer if (ndvi1 === null || ndvi2 === null || isNaN(ndvi1) || isNaN(ndvi2) || ndvi1 < -1 || ndvi1 > 1 || ndvi2 < -1 || ndvi2 > 1) { console.log('Invalid NDVI calculation.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (ndvi1 > ndvi2) { console.log('More green vegetation in August than September.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Not more green vegetation in August.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
